name: prestashopheaven/build-coding-standard
description: The shared PHP coding standard of the PrestaHaven modules and packages: the PHP-CS-Fixer config, the base PHPStan config, the PHPCS standard PrestaHavenCompatibility and the PHPUnit config template.

suggest.dealerdirect/phpcodesniffer-composer-ins: Registers the PHPCS standards of every package of type phpcodesniffer-standard (PrestaHavenCompatibility, PHPCompatibility). Require "^1.2" in the module and allow the plugin.
suggest.phpcompatibility/php-compatibility: The sniffs behind PrestaHavenCompatibility. Require "^10.0@alpha" in the module itself (alpha stability must be allowed by the root package).

prestashopheaven.use-when: A module or package needs its .php-cs-fixer.dist.php, tests/phpstan/phpstan.neon, phpcs.xml.dist or phpunit.xml.dist: include the shared base and add only its own exceptions.
